image_description: A close-up photograph of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) displayed against a neutral beige wall. The armor features a central vertical ridge, curved anatomical contours mimicking the pectoral muscles and abdomen, and visible rivets near the top edge. The surface is highly reflective with specular highlights indicating a smooth metal texture. Ornamental etched lines curve across the chest area.
